verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, and a closed data-to-training-to-deployment loop is a fair question for robotics development tools, so the axis applies. The evidence covers headless simulation, plugins, transport and simulated sensor-data generation, but documents nothing about ingesting collected robot data into model training or deploying trained models back to a fleet. Simulated sensor output is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
